import asyncio

async def fetch_success(task_id: int):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    return f"任务 {task_id} 成功"

async def fetch_fail(task_id: int):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
    raise ValueError(f"任务 {task_id} 发生错误")

async def main():
    # 并发执行 3 个任务，其中一个会抛出异常
    tasks = [
        fetch_success(1),
        fetch_fail(2),
        fetch_success(3),
    ]

    # 设置 return_exceptions=True，异常会被作为返回值捕获
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    # 遍历并区分正常结果与异常对象
    for i, res in enumerate(results, start=1):
        if isinstance(res, Exception):
            print(f"[{i}] 捕获到异常: {type(res).__name__} - {res}")
        else:
            print(f"[{i}] 正常完成: {res}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

    # 设置 return_exceptions=True，异常不会中断其他任务
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    for index, res in enumerate(results):
        if isinstance(res, Exception):
            print(f"[{index}] 失败: {type(res).__name__} -> {res}")
        else:
            print(f"[{index}] 成功: {res}")

    asyncio.run(main())
